item.text:
For a non-empty topic, `get_relevant_context` does a pure-symbolic lookup through the cache-coherent entity index (`entity_index.search_classes()`), then filters out weak hits below the `0.45` relevance floor before returning structured `ContextItem` records. If the topic is blank, it switches to a list-all path that enumerates all ontology instances from the project KG via SPARQL quad iteration.

I relied on the recorded entries `get_relevant_context: pure-symbolic context retrieval via entity index (topic) or list-all (no topic)` and `get_relevant_context: relevance floor (0.45) drops noise hits; topic-aware empty-state is honest`.
